notes.title: Mad Tower Tycoon Leaves Early Access
notes.content:
Mad Tower Tycoon Leaves Early Access

After more than 2 years of development, "Mad Tower Tycoon" is leaving early access.
I would like to thank you for the numerous tips, bug reports and suggestions for improvement from the community.

Of course, the game will continue to be patched and updated.
A version for MacOS is also available today.

Changelog:

EA.19.10.11A - EA.20.01.14A
- MacOS version available
- 7 scenarios added
- Achievements added
- New backgrounds added: Fir River, Diamond Beach, Moutains
- 10 New decoration objects added.
- Selection of antenna, ferris wheel and observatory improved.
- Pathfinding optimized. (Elevators with locked floors)
- Decoration: Blue armchair added
- Visitors now have better surnames.
- Hotkeys for construction menus are now sorted.
- Optionen: Reflections for water can be deactivated in the options.
- Optionen: Reduced maximum size for GUI.
- Languages updated: Turkish, Chinese Traditional, Japanese, Spanish
- GFX: Palms and stones improved.
- GFX: Some backgrounds have been revised.
- GFX: Cars replaced with new models.
- GFX: Added particles at pool.
- BUG: Sometimes cars collided.
- BUG: If you demolished an elevator, the lift settings were not deleted.
- BUG: One could build balconies and bridges over antennas, ferris wheel and observatory.
- BUG: If roof terraces were destroyed by fire, a burned-out hallway was created.
- BUG: If you replaced the lobby with a hallway, the lobby was not deleted.
- BUG: The tooltip of burned rooms was displayed in German.
- BUG: Skylobbies could not be demolished.
- BUG: Construction workers' pathfinding no longer worked correctly.
- BUG: Elevators did not work if you built them on the edge of the map.

notes.title: Update: EA.19.09.11A - EA.19.10.10A
notes.content:
EA.19.09.11A - EA.19.10.10A

- Added new objects: Ferris Wheel, Museum
- Added new shop variations.
- Fireworks Event added.
- Some filters revised.
- Skylobbys no longer have to be built on floor 15, 30 etc.
- Standard opening hours of attractions revised.
- Rental bonus tooltip: The calculated total rent is displayed.
- Tutorial: It is no longer possible to click on a wrong button.
- Discos, cinemas, theaters and Ocean World can now be built in the ground.
- Now certain rooms are needed to get a new star.
- Update lift: The process is now canceled if there is no space for the new lift.
- Visitors leave the building after about 18 hours.
- Performance improved.
- Some tooltips improved.
- Language updated: Japanese, Chinese Traditional, Spanish
- BALANCE: Bonus for rental period significantly reduced.
- BALANCE: Revised purchase prices and prestige of attractions.
- BUG: Quality of life was calculated incorrectly.
- BUG: Edge objects from the roof terrace were no longer displayed.
- BUG: The visitors could not enter large condominiums.
- BUG: The volume of the lift sounds and the helicopter could not be adjusted.
- BUG: The GUI size in the options did not work anymore.
- BUG: In the tutorial, an arrow had the wrong position.
- BUG: Material was created continuously, resulting in a crash (Memory Leak).
- BUG: Complaints were not updated immediately.
- BUG: Sleeping people in apartments jump on the bed when game play is loaded.
- BUG: Tenants of apartments have constantly performed the same action (just jumping on bed).
- BUG: Options -> Gameplay: The scroll window was not big enough.
- BUG: Visitors were created continuously. This resulted in crashes.
- BUG: Visitors could walk over observatory and antennas.
- BUG: You could build elevators on observatories and antennas.
- BUG: The subway was used, even if it was in need of renovation.
- BUG: Attractions visitors have ignored transportation satisfaction.
- BUG: Update lift (automatically tear off stairs): The first staircase was not demolished.

notes.title: New Update: EA.19.09.06A
notes.content:
EA.19.07.03A - EA.19.09.06A

- Added new objects: Observatory, Ballroom, Helicopter Pad, Theater
- Market situation added (demand from rental space).
- Max Level is now limited to 100.
- Skylobbys can now be built anywhere (at least floor 15).
- Room menu: Default working time is now highlighted in red.
- New construction contracts added.
- Added speech bubble and particle for church.
- No more unnecessary skill points are earned.
- Language updated: Spain, China Traditional.
- GFX: Trees and clouds are now rounded.
- BALANCE: Attractions are now visited more frequently and provide more visitors.
- BALANCE: Service rooms are now visited more frequently.
- BUG: Demolition of elevators did not work anymore.
- BUG: (Observatory) Graphic error of the preview object removed.
- BUG: When the building limit was deactivated, a building limit of 12 was displayed for some rooms.
- BUG: If you demolished the heliport or the observatory, a corridor was created.
- BUG: Some objects have been unlocked at the wrong level.
- BUG: Some construction contracts did not work.
- BUG: At observatories no outer wall was set.
- BUG: Radio towers and observatories had clipping errors in rooms under construction.
- BUG: Discos could cause a crash when initializing.
- BUG: Graphics bug at heliport and observatory removed.
- BUG: It was possible to build stairs over heliports.
- BUG: At helipad a balcony could be attached.
- BUG: Sometimes the crane was positioned incorrectly.
- BUG: In rare cases, there was a crash when you demolished a room.

notes.title: PATCHNOTES
notes.content:
PATCHNOTES

EA.19.04.29A - EA.19.06.29A
- Added new objects: chapel and chandelier
- Construction projects can now be prioritized.
- Lift menu: Added upgrade button (improves a 2x to 3x)
- Decorations now have different strong bonuses.
- It will now be displayed to which floor you are allowed to build.
- In the start options you can now disable the construction limit.
- Own rooms can now be closed (no more maintenance costs).
- Lift upgrade: Stairs can now be torn off automatically.
- Visitors now sit at the tables on the roof terrace.
- Visitors of rental apartments now sit on their balcony.
- Darker backgrounds for construction menu buttons.
- Performance improved.
- LANGUAGE: French, Japanese, Chinese Traditional updated
- BUG: If the mouse pointer was invisible, tooltips were still displayed.
- BUG: Fixed graphics errors (invisible walls) on some rooms.
- BUG: Fires could in rare cases cause a crash.
- BUG: When demolishing a multi-story room on floor 100, a hallway on floor 101 was created.
- BUG: Sometimes it was falsely indicated that a room is not rented.
- BUG: For some icons an incorrect tooltip was displayed.
- BUG: In rare cases you could not move the camera when the room menu was open.
- BUG: The fan from the casino did not turn.
- BUG: Some menus were not centered on all screen resolution.
- BUG: Room menu -> For some menus, the "Apply all settings" button was not displayed.
- BUG: Room menu -> Sometimes you could not open the DropDown menus.
- BUG: Visitors could no longer enter the art gallery.
- BUG: The shelter did not have the correct exterior wall.

EA.19.04.29A - EA.19.05.03A
- New Objects and rooms: Radiotower, Solar panel, Disco
- People will now run to the shelters when there is an evacuation going on
- Destruction: The stairs/Elevators that prevent the destruction/deconstruction are now highlighted
- Elevators can now also be build on roof terraces (roof-decks? that open air area on the roof)
- Daily XP amount now depend on the level of difficulty
- Shelters are not destroyed by earthquakes or fires anymore
- Building tooltips and Room menu: The current visitor count and the maximal visitor counts are now displayed.
- New Construction Orders/Quest have been added
- Spanish texts have been updated
- balance: Water, Electricity and Multimedia now produce 80 units
- Balance: reduced requirements for stars (now you only need 50 stars to declare independence from Britain )
- BUG: it was possible to build stairs on solar panels and radio towers
- BUG: clipping error for solar panels (roof) removed
- BUG: it was possible to build balconies on solar panels
- BUG: Save slot 16 did not work
- BUG: Removed clipping error for the disco
- BUG: "Delete Quest/Contract"-Button could not be clicked
- BUG: Sometimes after building a stair the graphic would not be updated correctly
- BUG: Light from casinos was not shown properly
- BUG: Automatic construction of hallways sometimes did not work

notes.title: PATCHNOTES: EA.19.03.27A - EA.19.03.29A
notes.content:
EA.19.03.27A – EA.19.03.29A

- People and rooms can now be saved as favorites
- Options: New tenant sound can now be disabled
- Performance of menus improved

- BALANCE: You need less visitors and prestige to get a star
- BALANCE: Income of parking spots improved

- BUG: If you deactivated the reach-limit, the bonuses for rooms were set even if you didn't build any rooms

- Translation improved: Spanish
- Translation improved: Traditional Chinese
- Translation improved: Japanese

notes.title: PATCHNOTES: EA. 19.02.17A - EA.19.03.13A
notes.content:
[b]Hi there!
[/b]

Here are the patchnotes for the latest updates. :)

EA.19.03.13A – EA. 19.02.17A
- Added balconies
- Added roof terraces
- Added lobby top up
- Start options: realistic mode to disable fantasy events like UFOs and zombies
- Start options: unlimited money
- New filter: rental-bonus
- New skill: increase room range
- New decoration objects: statues
- New decoration object: palm tree
- New background: Death Valley
- New lobby variations
- Contracts: You don't get building contracts for rooms you've built shortly before
- Room range: Only counts for floors (there's no limit for the left and right anymore)
- Lifts: button to enable/disalbe all floors
- Every attraction gives a global rental-bonus
- The night goes by faster (can be disabled in the options)
- Tooltips at rooms: complaints are shown
- Tooltips for start options
- Bridges can now be build on skylobbies
- Button to show/unlock all contracts
- Speech bubble: roof terraces
- Subway: You get more money if visitors use it
- Lobbies now reduce the stress of your visitors
- Rooms below or above a lobby get a rental-bonus of 10%
- In evacuations stairs are now primarily used
- Stairs can now be marked as an escape route
- Performance improved
- Pathfinding improved

- BALANCE: fire door, security cam and waiting rooms are unlocked at the start
- BALANCE: only 1 skill point per skill
- BALANCE: bridged now give 0,1 prestige

- Translation improved: Turkish
- Translation improved: Traditional chinese
- Translation improved: Spanish
- Translation improved: Japanese

- BUG: Fixed errors when building a bridge
- BUG: Fixed errors when updating a room
- BUG: Fixed some errors where the game could crash
- BUG: Despite the rain visitors of attractions have not decreased
- BUG: Some particels weren't displayed
- BUG: People visited roof terraces which were still under construction
- BUG: Building menu wasn't animated
- BUG: Reach of hotel cleaning wasn't correct 
- BUG: Sometimes cleaners and janitors couldn't find the way
- BUG: You could demolish skylobbies that had stairs on them
- BUG: Clipping-errors of windows were fixed
- BUG: Room diagram showed wrong values if you didn't built a room
- BUG: Graphic-errors at roofs were fixed
- BUG: Borderlines weren't animated anymore
- BUG: Savegames weren't saved correctly
- BUG: Sometimes visitors didn't enter the building anymore
- BUG: “Fast night“ didn't work if you loaded a savegame
- BUG: RoomGFX wasn't correctly updated
- BUG: Fans didn't move anymore
- BUG: You couldn't flip stairs in older savegames
- BUG: Pathfinding failed in closed lifts

notes.title: PATCHNOTES: EA.18.12.12A - EA.19.02.16A
notes.content:
EA.18.12.12A - EA.19.02.16A

- Stairs can now be flipped.
- Elevators: Restrict boarding / exit works better now.
- The needs are displayed in the room menus.
- New menu added: Elevator & Stairs Overview
- Lift menu revised: settings for several times, lift position is displayed etc.
- The tooltips of the resources now show the production and consumption.
- The sound of the subway can be disabled in the options.
- If you tear down a room under construction, you get back all the money.- Orders are no longer created randomly.
- Added new orders
- Elevator numbers: Purple = Passenger wants to go to this floor.
- Lifts with multiple shafts added.
- Elevator graphics have been improved.
- Room overview: Turnover from the last day is now displayed (restaurants and attractions).
- In the options you can disable the pan of the camera.
- New room added: Hotel reception
- Figures leave restaurants, shops, etc. at closing time.
- Non-rented rooms no longer generate noise and dirt.
- "Shop closed" signs added.
- The tooltip of events now shows which event is active.
- Added new office graphics.
- Added new tooltips and help texts.
- Performance verbessert
- Several languages have been updated.
- BALANCE: Offices now have a greater tolerance for noise.
- BUG: LiftMenu -> "Apply all settings" did not work correctly.
- BUG: Pathfinding could make a crash.
- BUG: Options -> Resolution: Sometimes "Option A" was displayed.
- BUG: Build stairs -> Collision did not work correctly.
- BUG: Icons of larger elevators was not positioned correctly.
- BUG: Clipping bug at design stairs and escalator removed.
- BUG: You could not name stairs.
- BUG: Several GUI bugs removed.
- BUG: People walking to the parking garage ran through walls.
- BUG: Number of people transported by large elevators was incorrect.
- BUG: Elevators from saved games did not work properly.
- BUG: Zombies used the subway.
- BUG: Visitors no longer spawn at entrances that are still under construction.
- BUG: It happened that you had duplicate orders.
- BUG: Elevator waiting time jumps back to "Very short".
- BUG: In rare cases, a crash occurred when people left the building.
- BUG: Restaurants -> Doors did not open at the correct time.
- BUG: Specialists (construction workers etc.) were sometimes deleted.
- BUG: Closed signs of restaurants and shops did not work properly.
- BUG: Hotel tenants and parking tenants were sometimes deleted.
- BUG: Elevator numbers were not colored when elevators were switched to transparent.
- BUG: Sometimes elevators were removed when a shaft had been demolished.
- BUG: Visitors have entered closed shops.
- BUG: Some visitors were not deleted when leaving the building.
- BUG: Condominiums had no color border.
- BUG: When building a bridge, two objects were created.
- BUG: The floor limit did not apply to stairs.
- BUG: Large rooms could be built over the Skylobby floor.
- BUG: When you have demolished a room, the people stayed in the room.

notes.title: PATCHNOTES: EA.18.11.16A - EA.18.12.11A
notes.content:
v. EA.18.11.16A - v. EA.18.12.11A
- Added two new events
- Performance improved.
- AI improved by cleaning ladies.
- Visitors now spawn at parking lots.
- An icon appears in hotel rooms if no hotel cleaning exists.
- Attractions are now much more visited and attract more visitors.
- Attractions: -50% visitors when the room is in the basement.
- Complaints are now displayed as icons
- Construction Tooltip: Now the needs are displayed.
- Each room now requires a different amount of power, water & multimedia.
- Electrical boxes etc .: It will now show how much they produce.
- The rental bonus increases by 1% per day until the renter moves out.
- Shops in the basement now have a rental penalty of 15%
- If a visitor has 100% stress, he only uses stairs.
- Filters are automatically activated when building rooms with reach. (can be deactivated in the options)
- Filter color for room range is green again
- New filters: cover of server room, storage room, toilet, laundry, medical center, shelter, conference room and bank
- Filter buttons are only displayed when the room has been unlocked.
- Complaint icons can now be disabled
- Room menu: An icon is displayed when there is maintenance nearby.
- Room menu: Icon for Rental Bonus and Malus added.
- Room menu: An icon is displayed if an extinguishing system is nearby.
- Japanese language updated
- Spanish language updated
- Turkish language updated
- Chinese language updated
- Chinese (Traditional) language updated
- BALANCE: Complaints about passenger traffic will now be influenced by the level of difficulty.
- BALANCE: Range of security camera, waiting area, security room, hotel cleaning, recycling, extinguishing system, maintenance and garbage bins increased
- BALANCE: Noise spread (up and down) reduced.
- BALANCE: Shops no longer complain about noise.
- BUG: If you built a sky lobby, got a wrong message.
- BUG: Hotel cleaning filter did not update.
- BUG: Waypoints for hotels were wrongly positioned.
- BUG: (Chinese) Unlock text was incorrect.
- BUG: Tenants have not entered the building at the right time.
- BUG: In the build tooltip some icons were black.
- BUG: Fixed an error in the calculation of traffic.
- BUG: The construction of corridors was sometimes free.
- BUG: If you replaced a staircase, you did not get any money for the old stairs.
- BUG: Sometimes visitors are frozen at entrances & parking lots.

notes.title: PATCHNOTES: EA.18.10.31A - EA.18.11.15A
notes.content:
v. EA.18.10.31A - v. EA.18.11.15A

- Added first set of decoration objects.
- Game settings: Large lifts can now be activated (higher person capacity)
- Bank, warehouse, server room, conference room, medical center, toilet, laundry and shelters now give a rental bonus for nearby rooms
- Game Settings: Range Restriction for Restaurant, Warehouse, Server Room, Toilet, Medical Center, Laundromat, Conference Room, Bank and Shelter can be disabled.
- Additional lobby entrances can now be built.
- Opening time / working hours of rooms can now be set.
- Three new skills to increase the capacity of lifts.
- Earthquake: Destroyed rooms are now displayed as burned down.
- Ingame Options: "Exit to OS" button added
- Options: Dense fog can be activated for background.
- Lift Sound is now disabled when elevators are transparent
- Room Menu (Maintenance): Renovation Priority is now disabled
- Load / Save menu is now scrollable with scroll wheel
- Turkish, Japanese, French and Chinese language updated
- BALANCE: Skill effects increased
- BUG: Opening hours / working hours were not saved
- BUG: Figures stopped at the entrance as long as they were not visible.
- BUG: (Game Settings) "Disable Range" did not work
- BUG: Apply settings for all rooms -> working time / opening time was not accepted
- BUG: Security cameras did not work.
- BUG: When a room was renovated, there was sometimes a crash.
- BUG: Laundromats have not given a bonus for rental apartments.
- BUG: The tooltip of burned rooms displayed "<NAME>".
- BUG: Demolition of entrances did not work correctly.
- BUG: (Chinese language) Tutorial texts were too small.
- BUG: Sometimes lights were not activated.
- BUG: (Spanish) Skill texts were displayed incorrectly.
- BUG: Parking positions for lifts did not work.
- BUG: If you pressed "F2", the demolition mode was not activated.

notes.title: PATCHNOTES: v. EA.18.10.30B
notes.content:
v. EA.18.10.25B - v. EA.18.10.30B

- Lifts: You can now set the movement. (Shortest way, Only from top to bottom etc.)
- Lifts: You can now set the parking position for day and night.
- Japanese language added.
- Game speed: Space = Pause (Toggle), 1 = Slow, 2 = Normal, 3 = Fast
- Turkish language has been updated.
- Options. A window appears to accept the options.
- Splash-Screen: The settings can be reset with "F12".
- Skylobby floors: Now a message appears that only Skylobbys can be built on this floor.
- BALANCE: Express Lift is now activated at 3 stars.
- BUG: Color filter for attractions was white.
- BUG: Noise spread too far to the right.
- BUG: It could happen that offices and apartments complain about too few guests.
- BUG: The figures always used the stairs furthest to the right.
- BUG: The noise display for all rooms was completely filled.

notes.title: PATCHNOTES
notes.content:
PATCHNOTES 

v. EA.18.10.25A
- Complaints about too high rent prices are only carried out at 6 o'clock, because otherwise the tenant could be satisfied within 5 minutes.
- BALANCE: The cleaning ladies clean the hotel rooms a little faster.
- BALANCE: Tenants of offices and apartments no longer complain so often about the high passenger traffic.
- BUG: Missions were unlocked when you went to the main menu.
- BUG: Save / Load Menu: Sometimes the menu would scroll down by itself.
- BUG: "Days that the tenant is already in this room" starts at 0 again after loading a savegame. 
- BUG: The build menus could not be closed with ESC or right click.
- BUG: "Option A" was sometimes displayed in the lift menu.
- BUG: Shops -> The complaint that there was too little passenger traffic was usually not reported.
- BUG: The correct resolution was not displayed in window mode.
- BUG: Options -> Sometimes the window mode was not activated.

v. EA.18.10.23B
- Controls: Scrolling (Left Mouse Button), Exit Build Mode / Deselect Object (Right Mouse Button)
- Rooms that are being renovated or under construction will generate a lot of noise and dirt.
- Buy land: Will be more expensive the further you get to the edge of the map.
- If you tear down a room, you get back 25% of the purchase price.
- BALANCE: Required XP has been reduced.
- BALANCE: Required prestige has been reduced.
- BUG: Skills that reduce noise did not work.

v. EA.18.10.23A
- Maintenance: The janitors no longer have a range limit
- Maintenance: Within reach, the condition of rooms decreases more slowly
- Added function to apply room settings for all rooms of the same type
- Stairs can now be replaced with new stairs
- The room menu now shows the Prestige
- If you tear down an elevator, a window appears to confirm the action
- BALANCE: Parking revenue has been increased
- BUG: You could build with 1 star to floor 100
- BUG: (Track person )The camera will no longer jump to the edge of the map if a person has left the building
